articles.title: New jobs held by people in 20s, 30s decrease to record low in Q1
articles.description: The number of new jobs held by people in their 20s and 30s fell to a record low in the first quarter, government data showed Sunday. A combined 2.36 million new jobs were held by people in their 20s and 30s in the January-March period, down 23,000 from a year earlier, according to data from the Korean Statistical Information Service, an online portal operated by the Ministry of Data and Statistics.
